Wikipedia mentions 2011 questions about contributions tied to a former campaign treasurer (not a case against him). The 2023 spouse-account trades drew news coverage; his office said all were disclosed within 45 days and an amendment fixed a clerical date error; no Ethics Committee action reported. Ethics, 2026-10-14: Office of Congressional Conduct (formerly OCE) public investigations table read directly, all pages covering Oct 2016–Mar 4, 2026 (pages 1–5 of 13): no referral names him. The table excludes matters closed in preliminary review and dismissals the Committee accepted. ethics.house.gov (the Ethics Committee's own statements) was refused by the fetch tool and could not be read; no Committee action was found in news. A news search on his 2023 spouse-account trades and ethics complaints found no OCE/Ethics action; NPR's Sept 2021 list of members with late stock-trade disclosures does not include him.
